protocol.title: Operating Protocol
protocol.subtitle: << WHAT WORKING WITH ME LOOKS LIKE >>

items.name: Ownership
items.rest: Comfortable taking a feature from a half-formed Figma or a paragraph of requirements all the way through frontend, backend, infrastructure and deploy — no handoffs.

items.name: Stack
items.rest: React / Next.js on web, React Native (Expo) on mobile, NestJS / Fastify / Express on the server. CI/CD, testing, Docker by default; self-host when it makes sense, AWS / Vercel / Hetzner when it doesn't.

items.name: Throughput
items.lead: Agentic AI is core to how I work.
items.rest: Agents carry the work end to end — I built the pipeline that has them track, finish and verify it, so my time goes to architecture, review and decisions. Day to day that's Claude Code, Codex and Orca; it's also how I build small tailored tools fast. On the infrastructure side I run self-hosted inference for a corporate stack — gateways, routing, Ollama / vLLM / LiteLLM.

items.name: Comms
items.rest: Used to working with US clients from Sofia, Bulgaria (UTC+2). Operates in English, Ukrainian and Russian.

dossier.title: Selected Dossier
dossier.subtitle: << FIELD RECORD — BUILT MOSTLY FOR US SMBS · CLICK TO EXPAND >>

cases.name: CargoFinance
cases.tease: Accounting back-office for US logistics carriers
cases.desc: Multi-tenant accounting back-office for US logistics carriers, live with paying tenants. Loads stream in from the TMS, and it runs weekly settlements, statements, commissions, payroll and payouts —
cases.descBold: integrated with NetSuite and Wells Fargo
cases.descAfter: . Automated pipelines keep the syncs running, move tenants off a legacy system side by side and keep the in-app help current; an AI copilot answers from the tenant's own data.

cases.name: ClaraHR
cases.tease: Driver onboarding system — chatbot interviews & files
cases.desc: Onboarding system for US truck drivers — a chatbot interviews them on whichever channel they prefer and files them in the carrier's system, replacing manual HR back-and-forth. Nine carriers and agencies to date.

cases.name: CargoHub
cases.tease: Public freight marketplace with in-product AI dispatch
cases.desc: Public freight marketplace where US shippers and brokers browse partner carriers' trucks, post loads and book capacity directly. An in-product AI assistant handles routine booking and dispatch; accounts, live tracking and document flow are built in.

cases.name: CargoETL
cases.tease: Closed TMS — dispatcher dashboard + driver app
cases.desc: Closed TMS platform for US logistics carriers and dispatchers. I built and maintain
cases.descAfter: : the Next.js dispatcher dashboard and the React Native (Expo) driver app — order flow, live tracking, documents and dispatch comms.

cases.name: Altek TMS
cases.tease: First multi-year production project — TMS, since wound down
cases.desc: Earlier TMS for US logistics carriers and dispatchers — dispatcher dashboard plus driver app, covering order flow, live tracking and dispatch comms. My first multi-year production project; the service has since wound down.

cases.name: agent-tracking
cases.tease: Removes the bottlenecks of working with agents
cases.desc: When agents write most of the code, the human becomes the bottleneck: context is lost between sessions, work stops half-done, nobody re-checks fixes after deploy, and follow-ups live in someone's head. agent-tracking removes each one — work state lives in GitHub issues every agent keeps up, agents finish what they start and come to you only for decisions, shipped fixes are re-measured against production on a set date, and a daily brief shows what needs you across every repo.
cases.descBold: It's how I run three production products solo, and teammates have adopted it for their own repos.

cases.name: Upkeep
cases.tease: Major dependency upgrades, investigated by an agent
cases.desc: Routine updates merge themselves. Each major version gets an agent review of the upstream changes and an evidence-backed verdict: adoptable, migrated, blocked until the ecosystem catches up, or needs a human.
cases.descBold: The human makes only the merge decision.
